plain_text:
Jim Jordan appears in 504 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1935 to 1981. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Jim Jordan most often in Fibber McGee and Molly, Lux Radio Theatre, Crime and Peter Chambers, Lum and Abner, Sears Radio Theater, The Big Show, The Great Gildersleeve, and The Lone Ranger.

Characters credited here include Fibber McGee.
